observed: od -c after the rewrite: "x \r \n" input came out as "x \n" (CR byte dropped)
correction: b75428925d8b: sed -b, awk -v BINMODE=3, printf "%s%s", out, RT
lesson: Every sed/awk call of a text recipe on Windows passes sed -b or awk -v BINMODE=3.

correction: b75428925d8b: test i == 1 before reading the previous character (gawk substr(s, 0, 1) is the first character)
lesson: Never read position 0 with gawk substr; guard column 1 explicitly.

observed: driver installed "$j.jdk21.tmp" whenever cmp differed, without checking the awk exit status
correction: b75428925d8b: install only when the tool exits 0 and the line count is unchanged, else "REFUSED <step> <path>: line count changed"
lesson: A text recipe installs an output only after checking the tool's exit status and the line count.

observed: test_recipe.sh exit=1 with no FAIL line; second driver run aborted (grep no match, pipefail, set -e)
correction: b75428925d8b: { grep -r -l ... || true; } before the while loop
lesson: Every grep that feeds a pipeline under set -e -o pipefail ends with || true.

observed: FAIL escaped-quote: got s = "\\"unused"; ... (fixture passed through printf '%s', escapes not interpreted)
correction: b75428925d8b: printf '%b' for input and expected bytes
lesson: Build byte fixtures with printf '%b' and compare od output.

observed: FILE_MARKS.tsv: "JAVA21_CLEAN 1" and 2856 rows with only a path (awk -v RS=<file> replaced the record separator)
lesson: Never name an awk -v variable RS, FS, OFS, ORS, NR, NF, FNR or RT.

correction: 962d9cff9256: tr '\\' '/' then strip the worktree prefix; existing gate files normalised the same way
lesson: Normalise tool output paths before any join, and convert old and new outputs together.

observed: eclipse.jdt.ui residue: 0 errors (five "variable unused is already defined" rows existed)
correction: 962d9cff9256: the BOM list is read in BEGIN with getline instead of the NR == FNR idiom
lesson: Do not use NR == FNR when the first file can be empty.

observed: git sparse-checkout list printed C:/Program Files/Git/pom.xml for the pattern /pom.xml
lesson: Set MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 for any argument that starts with / and is not a path.

observed: PASS2 rows for "Eclipse UI Tests/..." had an empty line column (git appends a tab to +++ names with spaces)
lesson: Trim the trailing tab of git diff +++/--- header names.

observed: BusyShowWhileDialog.java:47: error: variable unused is already defined in method createButtonsForButtonBar(Composite)
correction: 962d9cff9256: rename_at.awk gives the declaration the smallest unusedN absent from the file
lesson: After a rename recipe, feed the compiler's "already defined" rows into a scope-aware second pass.

observed: SwitchTest.java:15: error: class, interface, enum, or record expected (13 rows, --release 21 only; file starts with EF BB BF)
correction: 962d9cff9256: files with "illegal character: '\ufeff'" in the baseline are left out of the residue
lesson: A differential gate excludes inputs the oracle cannot read in either run.

observed: ps -ef | grep -c '[a]pply_jdk21' printed 1 while no recipe ran (it matched the checking shell's command line)
correction: (procedure): match the process command name, not a shell line that contains it
lesson: Before replacing a script that may be running, check the exact process command, not a grep of the full process list.

observed: about 0.3 s per Java file with one awk process each; estimate one hour for eclipse.jdt.ui
correction: 962d9cff9256: one grep -r -l -Z per bundle selects files with a standalone _ token
lesson: Prefilter with one grep per tree; spawn per-file tools only for the hits.
